udt_union_v0.doc:
Aquarius AMM adapter.

Real Aquarius interface (docs.aqua.network, AquaToken/soroban-amm):
Router (mainnet): CBQDHNBFBZYE4MKPWBSJOPIYLW4SFSXAXUTSXJN76GNKYVYPCKWC6QUK
swap_chained(user, swaps_chain: Vec<(Vec<Address>, BytesN<32>, Address)>,
token_in, amount: u128, amount_with_slippage: u128) -> u128
Per-pool quoting: estimate_swap(in_idx: u32, out_idx: u32, amount: u128) -> u128

Pool resolution (v1.2): an admin-registered pool wins (ops can pin a
specific pool); otherwise the adapter asks Aqua's own router ON-CHAIN
via get_pools(tokens) and picks the pool with the deepest MIN-SIDE
reserves \xe2\x80\x94 every pool Aqua has or ever creates is tradeable here
permissionlessly, mirroring the Sushi adapter's factory fallback.
Safe because the caller's min_amount_out bounds the outcome whichever
pool executes. Multi-hop routing composes ABOVE this adapter (the
Router's execute_path chains single-hop adapter calls atomically).

Funds flow (AtomicSwap Router contract \xe2\x86\x92 this adapter):
The router PUSHES token_in to this adapte

void_v0.doc: The Aqua AMM router contract address
void_v0.name: AquaRouter

tuple_v0.doc: Registered pool for a directed pair (token_in, token_out)
tuple_v0.name: Pool

void_v0.doc: Two-step admin rotation: proposed new admin, pending acceptance.
void_v0.name: PendingAdmin

udt_struct_v0.doc: An Aquarius pool used for a pair.
udt_struct_v0.name: PoolInfo

fields.doc: Pool hash as used in swap_chained's swaps_chain
fields.name: pool_hash

fields.doc: The pool's token list (order defines estimate_swap indexes)
fields.name: tokens

function_v0.doc:
Execute a single-hop swap through Aquarius.

Expects `amount_in` of token_in to have been pushed to this contract
by the caller beforehand. Sends the output to `recipient` and returns
the actual amount out.
function_v0.name: swap

function_v0.doc: Quote a swap via the registered pool's estimate_swap.
function_v0.name: quote

function_v0.doc: Register the pool to use for a pair (both directions). Admin only.
function_v0.name: set_pool

function_v0.doc: Complete an admin rotation \xe2\x80\x94 callable only by the proposed admin,\nproving the new key is live before it holds power.
function_v0.name: accept_admin

function_v0.doc: Propose a new admin (two-step rotation). Admin only. The proposed\naddress must call `accept_admin` to take over, so a mistyped\ntransfer is recoverable until accepted.
function_v0.name: transfer_admin

function_v0.doc: Update the Aqua router address. Admin only.
function_v0.name: set_aqua_router
